project.description: What vexelray-gui-nfd needs from an operating system, as an interface: where the NFDe library is, how its strings are encoded, what a window handle is, and where a dialog may run. One vexelray-gui-nfd-<os> module implements it per OS; the facade finds that one through ServiceLoader. Depends on nothing, so the OS modules and the facade can both depend on it without depending on each other.
